sentence: This project develops a framework that lets machine learning models learn how scientific visualizations appear and generate visual representations without repeatedly processing the original data.
This project supports a series of conferences on algebraic geometry, a field of mathematics about solution sets of polynomial equations.
This project develops ways to keep robots safe when they use machine learning to process what they see.
This project moves a free open-source software package for physics simulations from one research group to a community of many contributors.
This project builds a tool that collects, sorts and identifies tiny microplastics in seawater using surface acoustic waves and machine learning.
This project works on computing devices that use light instead of electricity to solve optimization problems.
This project operates a laser facility that gives researchers powerful laser pulses for experiments.
This project builds semiconductor technologies that focus and steer a beam of electromagnetic waves with electronic control.
This project studies singular integrals, a type of mathematical object, in rough settings instead of smooth ones.
This project tests whether metal particles are present in ash from burned structures and whether human lungs could absorb them.
This project creates mathematical methods that let networked systems share limited resources and schedule actions safely despite timing delays.
This project studies a way to detect optical phase on a silicon photonic chip using digital signal processing instead of interferometer hardware.
This project tries to use DNA to build materials with controllable electronic and magnetic properties, aiming for magnetic topological insulators.
This project studies why male cichlid fish direct more aggression toward competitors that resemble themselves, using behavioral, genetic and brain analyses.
This project studies how spiking neural networks can do distributed learning over wireless edge environments despite limits on memory and bandwidth.
This project studies how floral scents that attract insect pollinators shape the diversification of tropical plants in the genus Anthurium.
This project makes DNA in bioreactors and uses it to build DNA hydrogels, then studies how their structure relates to their mechanical properties.
This project studies how soil fungi and bacteria interact to help plant roots get nutrients.
This project develops secure distributed algorithms that solve optimization problems from medical imaging and machine learning while sharing only small amounts of data.
